attorneys: Messrs. Walter L. Clark and John Ralph Wilson for petitioner., Mr. Nat Schmulowitz for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for writ of certiorari to. the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth’ Circuit is granted, but the consideration of the cause shall be limited to the question whether the Circuit Court. of Appeals erred in failing to review the rulings of the District Court in the progress of the trial, excepted to at the time and duly presented by a bill of exceptions.
